manualChecks.procedure: Capture every primary surface at its documented fixed viewport in dark and light themes; compare compactness, clipping, hierarchy, icons, and focus visuals against the current reference board.
Use keyboard only on every surface. Record tab order, activation keys, Escape behavior, focus containment, focus restoration, and visible focus.
Run Windows Narrator or NVDA through every primary action and input. Record announced name, role, state/value, dynamic status, and any unlabeled or duplicate control.
Enable a Windows high-contrast theme and verify text, focus, borders, selection, disabled controls, icons, and overlays remain distinguishable.
Disable Windows transparency and animations. Verify opaque fallbacks, no essential state conveyed only by animation, and no motion continues against the preference.
Verify primary surfaces at 100, 150, and 200 percent scaling without clipping, overlap, lost actions, or off-screen placement.
Move and reopen positioned surfaces across mixed-DPI monitors, including a portrait display and negative coordinates; verify correct monitor, bounds, focus, and restored placement.
